headline: Pemerintah Opens 2026 CPNS Recruitment Registration On 27 November
seoTitle: Pemerintah Opens 2026 CPNS Recruitment On 27 November
metaDescription: The government announces the 2026 CPNS recruitment starts on 27 November with 154,052 positions, utilizing face recognition technology for a fair process.
aiSummaryBullets: The government has scheduled the official registration period for the 2026 CPNS recruitment to commence on 27 November 2026.
A total of 154,052 positions are available across various sectors, including health, education, and law.
New security measures, including facial recognition technology and real-time result displays, have been implemented to ensure transparency.
aiContextParagraph: The Indonesian government, through the Ministry of Administrative and Bureaucratic Reform (PANRB), has officially announced the launch of the 2026 CPNS recruitment cycle. Starting 27 November 2026, the process will open with 154,052 available positions. To manage anticipated high applicant numbers, the Civil Service Agency (BKN) has allowed the creation of accounts on the SSCASN portal since 17 November 2026, specifically targeting the 1.47 million eligible contract workers (PPPK). Officials emphasize that the selection process will be strictly merit-based, incorporating advanced technology such as facial recognition and live score updates to prevent corruption or unfair influence. Amidst the preparations, members of the House of Representatives (DPR) have proposed additional cognitive assessments for applicants, though officials maintain a focus on technical readiness and administrative integrity throughout the upcoming national recruitment drive.
whyItIsViral: The topic is highly viral due to strong public search interest for government information and consistent coverage by four national news outlets.
